text:
Lena: seeing a spike in SCIM retries for a handful of customers since the 03:00 deploy - looks tied to SAML SSO logins failing with 'Assertion binding mismatch' and then KMS decryption errors in the provisioner. logs below.
Lena: ```ERROR saml: assertion binding 'urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Redirect' not allowed, expected 'urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST'
provisioner: decrypt_jwe failed: InvalidCiphertextException: alias "alias/redwood-scim" not found
SCIM: retrying user create (attempt 3) for tenant acme-corp
```
Amar: did we rotate the IdP cert/metadata this morning? quick check: any metadata import jobs run around 02:50? :thinking_face:
Lena: no cert rotation, but a metadata import task ran (infra/terraform) that pulled idp metadata from the new bucket. I grabbed the metadata and it looks like the <AssertionConsumerService> bindings list got reduced to only HTTP-Redirect in that file.
Kai: ah that would explain binding mismatch. Our SP expects HTTP-POST for the login flow. SCIM retry happens after SSO because the user record isn't created if SSO fails at auth. How did the metadata import compress the bindings?
Jess: onboarding note: some older IdPs publish both bindings; if metadata was truncated/normalized, the top entry might have only redirect. Can you paste the metadata fragment?
Lena: ```<AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Redirect" Location="https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs" index="0"/>```
Amar: we should accept both bindings or prefer POST when signature present. Short-term mitigation: update the SP config to allow HTTP-Redirect binding for that tenant and re-run provisioning. Long-term: fix metadata importer to preserve the full ACS list.
sec-bot: alert: 6 tenants affected, avg SCIM retry per tenant=4, error-rate increase +120% since 03:00.
deploy-bot: deploy id=deploy-2026-03-21-0300 completed by infra-ci in us-east-1.
Kai: KMS error looks separate but related: provisioner stores JWE-encrypted service tokens in DB and tries to decrypt during provisioning. If the provisioning flow aborts mid-way (missing user), we still attempt decrypt + cleanup and hit alias mapping. Check KMS alias resolution in the importer job - maybe it rewrote alias names when copying metadata bucket config.
Jess: quick workaround: set sp.allow_redirect_binding=true for affected tenants and kick the SCIM queue (replay failed jobs). That should unblock customer signups within minutes.
Amar: can we replay without reencrypt? If alias truly missing we'll still fail on decrypt. Need to verify KMS aliases in account: `aws kms list-aliases --key-id <key-id>` for the infra account.
Lena: I checked: alias/redwood-scim exists in prod, but the importer job set KMS_ALIAS_OVERRIDE to "redwood-scim-prod" for a subset of tenants (typo). So the provisioner tried alias "alias/redwood-scim-prod" which doesn't exist -> InvalidCiphertextException.
Kai: ok root cause: metadata importer accidentally changed both the IdP ACS list AND the KMS alias env var for a feature flag rollout. Two unrelated changes in one deploy = cascade.
Jess: plan -> (1) revert metadata importer change (rollback import) to restore ACS list for affected tenants; (2) fix env var for KMS_ALIAS_OVERRIDE for the subset; (3) patch importer to validate ACS bindings and alias names before writing; (4) requeue SCIM retries.
Amar: I'll open a tiny PR with the alias fix and a hotfix to allow redirect binding per-tenant as an immediate guardrail. Canary to 5 tenants first.
Lena: I'll roll the rollback for the metadata import now and run `scim-provisioner replay --filter tenant=acme-corp --max-attempts 0` after alias fix.
sec-bot: incident created: INC-2026-03-21-01 (severity P2) - assigned to @Amar for hotfix, @Lena for replay, @Kai for importer patch.
Kai: note for postmortem: avoid packing unrelated infra changes in a single import job; add unit test for ACS list preservation. Also add a KMS alias validation step on service start.
Jess: thumbs up. I'll notify account managers for the affected tenants and add a short status note.
Amar: ETA for hotfix PR review ~ 20m, will request expedited review. If anyone sees residual InvalidCiphertextException after alias fix, ping me and we'll fallback to reencrypting tokens with the correct key.
Lena: thanks all - doing the rollback now, will post updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:
